name: Austria
sources: GDP about $165bn and population 7.68m (World Bank / Statistik Austria, 1990).

Inflation 3.3% (Statistik Austria consumer price index, 1990). The Hartwaehrungspolitik pegged the schilling to the D-Mark, so the OeNB followed the Bundesbank; its discount rate reached 6.5% in 1990 with money-market rates near 7.5%.
Tax revenue 40% of GDP (OECD Revenue Statistics, 1990) and general government debt 57% of GDP.
Defence 1.0% of GDP - the lowest in Western Europe. The 1955 State Treaty imposed permanent neutrality; the Bundesheer is a militia of about 55,000 with no projection. Strength 6.
Oil 0.02 mbd from OMV's Matzen field in the Vienna Basin.
Austria applied for EC membership on 17 July 1989, which is the strategic fact of this start.
